subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 7: /c/ (cat, cop, cap, can); differentiates c and o; identifies rhyming words

show.line: Listen. c, c, cat. c, c, cap! Cat starts with c.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with c, as in cat?
Say the sound with me. c, as in cat!
Listen. c, a, n. What word is it?
Is it c or o? Listen. Cop.

hints: Open your mouth and click at the back. c, c, c.
Cat and kite start with the same sound.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Listen. c, a, p.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! c, a, p makes cap.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's do it together. c, a, p. Cap!

parent_line: Can hear the c sound and blend words like cat, cap and can.
